lines.trans: Viktor Petrovich, you have a visitor.
She says she is an acquaintance of yours, Elena Sokolova.
I do not want to see her, I cannot.
Tell her I am not here, tell her I died.
Wait, why.
Did you not tell me yourself that it was allowed?

words.gloss: to me (мне некогда = I have no time)

lines.trans: Well, a little bit is allowed.
I will not hide the truth from you.
At the very...
And so what?
We sailed without a captain for half a year.
We simply must bring in a new head chef.
So allow me to introduce our new head chef to you.
